entries.name: Superior Darkvision
entries: Your darkvision has a radius of 120 feet.

entries.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: You have disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight when you, the target of your attack, or whatever you are trying to perceive is in direct sunlight.

entries.name: Moonlit Ward
entries: You have resistance to necrotic damage.

entries.name: Moon Lore
entries: You are proficient in the {@skill Arcana} skill. In addition, you have advantage on Intelligence ({@skill History}), ({@skill Arcana}) or ({@skill Nature}) checks related to the moon, the stars, the tides and the passage of time.

entries.name: Moon Stealth
entries: You have advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made at night or in dim light.

entries.name: Lunar Rider
entries: You have advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Animal Handling}) checks made to calm, ride or command a lunar dragon.

entries.name: Sunward Ward
entries: You have resistance to radiant damage.

entries.name: Sun Lore
entries: You have advantage on Intelligence ({@skill History}), ({@skill Religion}) or ({@skill Nature}) checks related to the sun, light and royalty.

entries.name: Solar Radiance
entries: As a bonus action, you can shine with sunlight, shedding bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet for 1 minute. While you shine, you have advantage on Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) checks. Once you use this trait, you cannot use it again until you finish a short rest.

entries.name: Noble Pride
entries: You are proficient in the {@skill Persuasion} skill.

entries.name: Solar Rider
entries: You have advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Animal Handling}) checks made to calm, ride or command a solar dragon.
